verbatim_quote.english_translation: reviewer approved = accepted (reviewer technical APPROVED + PO_REVIEW_PENDING counts as Manager acceptance for closure)

extracted_decision.summary: Standing order: reviewer technical APPROVED + PO_REVIEW_PENDING counts as Manager acceptance for closure.
extracted_decision.rationale: Reduces manager overhead when the reviewer grants technical approval.
alternatives: Require the explicit phrase 'Approved for closure'
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Faster closure, but the strict approval-word gate later overrode it.
